rows.label: qst500202_msg0001
rows.name:
The view from here is quite
spectacular, mo!

rows.label: qst500202_msg0002
rows.name:
This is the best view Foorara has
ever seen, mo.

rows.label: qst500202_msg0003
rows.name:
And don't say I haven't lived long
enough to say that, mo.

rows.label: qst500202_msg0004
rows.name:
Watching the people of Gula from here,
they seem rather easygoing, mo.

rows.label: qst500202_msg0005
rows.name:
Maybe it's because they were born in
a blessed land with plenty of food
and haven't suffered much, mo.

rows.label: qst500202_msg0006
rows.name:
There was a war in the past, but the
people's basic nature hasn't changed
much, mo.

rows.label: qst500202_msg0007
rows.name:
And don't say I haven't lived long
enough to judge life, mo.

rows.label: qst500202_msg0008
rows.name:
Anyway, Foorara is hungry and wants
to eat a mountain of mushrooms, mo...

rows.label: qst500202_msg0009
rows.name:
The Fortis Trade Guild travel guide
says you can't travel on an empty
stomach, mo.

rows.label: qst500202_msg0010
rows.name:
So stuffing myself with mushrooms is
a perfectly valid purpose for a trip,
mo.

rows.label: qst500202_msg0011
rows.name:
Anyway, maybe we meet
again. Best of luck!
